Only Finance Office budget updates affect the total. There are no withdrawals in the records; administrative messages do not change the budget.

Applying all budget updates in order gives these checkpoints:

| Through record | Budget |
|---|---:|
| #0001 | $1,460K |
| #0400 | $1,401K |
| #0800 | $1,955K |
| #1200 | $859K |
| #1600 | $1,491K |

The net change from the initial budget is **+$31K**.

ANSWER: $1491K
